## Review and closure

- [ ] Linked to the correct tracking issue and existing plan/milestone authority.
- [ ] No direct-to-main implementation; concurrent work has disjoint file ownership.
- [ ] Claims are supported by merged code/tests/receipts or identified as proposed.
- [ ] Security, performance and scientific claims use relevant independent evidence.
- [ ] The issue ledger will be updated with this PR's merge SHA and gate status.

See [AIEN issue-first delivery](https://github.com/aien-dev/aien-architecture/blob/main/docs/process/ISSUE_FIRST_DELIVERY.md). Existing repository-local instructions and PR templates take precedence over these organization fallbacks.
